data.information:
Adult N95 masks are available for community members at the following locations, per Kittitas County Public Health Department on Facebook:

  • Kittitas County Public Health

    • 507 N Nanum Street, Suite 102, Ellensburg, WA 98926

    • Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–4:00 PM

  • Upper Kittitas County District Court

    • 700 E 1st St, Cle Elum, WA 98922

    • Monday–Thursday: 8:00 AM–4:30 PM

    • Friday: 8:00 AM–12:00 PM and 1:00–4:30 PM

Distribution is limited to one mask per household member. One person from the household may pick up masks for all members of their household. All household members do not need to be present.

For example, a household of 4 may receive up to 4 masks.

Masks are available while supplies last.
